title: Native Arena Recycling
objective: Qualify reuse of GMP-freed checkpoint blocks without relaxing exact arena limits or allocator provenance

handoff.summary: Prototype recycling of GMP-freed checkpoint blocks with unchanged exact arena limits and source-transparent mathematics. Final canonical volume16 artifact completes 1012 first-effort cases: 979 accepts, zero exceptions or accepted-answer mismatches; all64 words unchanged on1010 formerly nonexceptional cases. All256 affected-regime fields agree across fmpz/GMP/JavaScript. Includes allocator cache-fingerprint dependency fix and four passing focused allocator/provenance tests. Not release-ready.
risks: Controlled1010-field first-effort opt pilot is0.17% slower overall. Selected9-round/32-call repeat shows up to5.02% regression, h5+1.19%, h2+2.94%. No zero-regression claim; optimize generic size-class overhead and remeasure.
Four-platform native/WASI qualification and normative architecture review remain outstanding. Sanitizer executable is Unix-only.
Mathematical volume16 source remains experimental and exceeds unchanged source allowance; allocator success does not qualify it for production.
Initial focused command misspelled the existing allocator test path; Node ignored that nonexistent pattern. The subsequent correctly named command explicitly ran all4 tests successfully.
next_steps: Controlled1010-field comparison and14-field longer repeat are complete, preserving identical mathematical source/outputs and excluding two old memory exceptions explicitly. Resolve small-field overhead, add non-cubic workloads, and repeat before promotion.
